es.hero_lead: Entrenamiento técnico de Factronics Venezuela, distribuidor oficial de Videojet. Genera evaluaciones a medida para las impresoras TTO Videojet 6210, 6230, DataFlex 6320, 6330, 6420 y 6530. Elige modelos, cantidad, tiempo y tipos de pregunta; el motor combina un banco técnico con cálculos de taller.
es.hero_note: 100 % offline en el navegador · sin registro · español, inglés y portugués
es.models_lead: Las preguntas se filtran por modelo. La 6230 no hereda las prestaciones de la 6330/6530, y la 6210/6320/6420 tienen su propia arquitectura, consumibles y procedimientos.
es.features_title: No es un banco fijo de 100 preguntas.
es.features_lead: Cada sesión se construye con filtros, aleatoriedad controlada y seguimiento de lo que ya viste.
es.feature_1_d: Un examen solo de 6530, uno combinado 6210 + 6420, o toda la familia. Sin preguntas fuera de contexto.
es.feature_2_d: Selección simple, múltiple, completar, descripción de componentes, corrección de fallas, cálculos y significado de errores.
es.feature_3_d: Banco de 366 preguntas y 100 cálculos con valores técnicos. El motor prioriza las que aún no has visto.
es.feature_4_d: De 5 a 100 preguntas y de 0 a 180 minutos, o sin límite.
es.feature_5_d: Interfaz, preguntas, opciones y explicaciones en español, inglés y portugués.
es.feature_6_d: Puntaje, desglose por tipo, revisión con explicación, autoevaluación de preguntas abiertas, CSV e impresión.
es.how_1_d: Marca los modelos y los tipos de pregunta que necesitas repasar.
es.how_2_d: Cantidad, duración, orden aleatorio y prioridad a preguntas no vistas.
es.how_3_d: Responde con cronómetro, recibe el puntaje y estudia cada explicación.
es.types_lead: La selección simple comprueba datos. La múltiple obliga a discriminar. Completar exige recall. Los cálculos y casos abiertos demuestran criterio técnico.
es.type_single_d: Una respuesta correcta entre cuatro. Especificaciones, números de parte, modos y conceptos.
es.type_multi_d: Varias respuestas correctas, con crédito parcial opcional. Discrimina afirmaciones verdaderas y falsas.
es.type_fill_d: Escenarios de auditoría y servicio con uno o dos espacios. Sin opciones: recuperación activa.
es.type_describe_d: Explica función, principio, P/N y mantenimiento. Se autoevalúa con rúbrica.
es.type_calc_d: Encoder, autonomía, consumo, costo, ahorro de ribbon y rendimiento. Casos con valores técnicos fijos y variantes por equipo.
es.type_errmap_d: Identifica qué indica un código de falla y cuál es la primera acción correcta.
es.type_errorfix_d: Casos reales: causa, diagnóstico y procedimiento. Se autoevalúa con rúbrica.

en.hero_lead: Technical training by Factronics Venezuela, an official Videojet distributor. Build custom assessments for the Videojet TTO 6210 and 6230, and the DataFlex 6320, 6330, 6420 and 6530. Choose models, length, time and question types; the engine combines a technical bank with workshop calculations.
en.hero_note: 100% offline in the browser · no sign-up · Spanish, English and Portuguese
en.models_lead: Questions are filtered by model. The 6230 does not inherit 6330/6530 performance, and the 6210/6320/6420 have their own architecture, consumables and procedures.
en.features_title: Not a fixed bank of 100 questions.
en.features_lead: Every session is built with filters, controlled randomness and tracking of what you have already seen.
en.feature_1_d: A 6530-only exam, a combined 6210 + 6420 exam, or the whole family. No out-of-context questions.
en.feature_2_d: Single choice, multiple choice, fill-in, component description, fault correction, calculations and error meaning.
en.feature_3_d: A 366-question bank and 100 calculations with technical values. The engine prioritises what you have not seen.
en.feature_4_d: From 5 to 100 questions and 0 to 180 minutes, or no limit.
en.feature_5_d: Interface, questions, options and explanations in Spanish, English and Portuguese.
en.feature_6_d: Score, type breakdown, explained review, open-question self-assessment, CSV and print.
en.how_1_d: Tick the models and question types you need to review.
en.how_2_d: Length, duration, random order and priority for unseen questions.
en.how_3_d: Answer against the clock, get your score and study every explanation.
en.types_lead: Single choice checks facts. Multiple choice forces discrimination. Fill-in requires recall. Calculations and open cases demonstrate technical judgement.
en.type_single_d: One correct answer out of four. Specifications, part numbers, modes and concepts.
en.type_multi_d: Several correct answers, with optional partial credit. Discriminates true from false statements.
en.type_fill_d: Audit and service scenarios with one or two blanks. No options: active recall.
en.type_describe_d: Explain function, principle, P/N and maintenance. Rubric-based self-assessment.
en.type_calc_d: Encoder, autonomy, consumption, cost, ribbon saving and throughput. Cases with fixed technical values and variants per model.
en.type_errmap_d: Identify what a fault code means and the first correct action.
en.type_errorfix_d: Real cases: cause, diagnosis and procedure. Rubric-based self-assessment.
en.android_title: The same training, in your pocket.
en.android_lead: Native Android app from Factronics TTO Lab, written in Java with no WebView. Works offline with a local bank, timer, model selection and all three languages.
en.android_b1: Native, fast interface with no external dependencies.
en.android_b2: Filters by model, length, time and question type.
en.android_b3: Questions, options and explanations in ES / EN / PT.
en.android_b4: Signed APK, direct install and offline operation.

en.faq_title: What to know before you start.
en.faq_1_q: Do I need an account or a connection?
en.faq_1_a: No. Everything runs on your device and progress is saved in the browser or the app. The first web visit needs a connection; after that the PWA can open offline.
en.faq_2_a: The material was prepared by Factronics and Khristyan Hidalgo from technical documentation and field experience. It was not requested or authorised by Videojet; trademarks belong to their owners.
en.faq_3_a: You self-assess them with a rubric shown at the end. The score is provisional until you complete that self-assessment.
en.faq_4_q: Can I use the same progress on web and Android?
en.faq_4_a: They are separate local stores. On the web you can export and import JSON; on Android progress stays on the device and results can be shared.

pt.faq_title: O que saber antes de começar.
pt.faq_1_a: Não. Tudo roda no seu dispositivo e o progresso fica salvo no navegador ou no aplicativo. A primeira visita à web precisa de conexão; depois o PWA pode abrir offline.
pt.faq_2_q: As perguntas são oficiais da Videojet?
pt.faq_2_a: O material foi elaborado pela Factronics e Khristyan Hidalgo com documentação técnica e experiência de campo. Não foi solicitado nem autorizado pela Videojet; as marcas pertencem aos seus titulares.
pt.faq_3_q: Como são avaliadas as perguntas abertas?
pt.faq_3_a: Você mesmo avalia com uma rubrica exibida no final. A nota é provisória até concluir essa autoavaliação.
pt.faq_4_q: Posso usar o mesmo progresso na web e no Android?
pt.faq_4_a: São armazenamentos locais independentes. Na web você pode exportar e importar JSON; no Android o progresso fica no dispositivo e os resultados podem ser compartilhados.
